en: iShares Core S&P 500 UCITS ETF USD (Accumulating)

manager: BlackRock Asset Management Ireland Limited (fund: iShares VII plc)
legal_form: UCITS ETF, sub-fund (share class USD Accumulating) of iShares VII plc, Ireland; physical replication ('Product Structure: Physical', 'Methodology: Physical Replication'); 'UK Reporting Status: Yes'; fund launch date 18-May-2010, share class launch date 19-May-2010; benchmark 'S&P 500 Index'. The factsheet's trading table lists the London Stock Exchange (CSPX in USD, CSP1 in GBP) and Euronext Amsterdam (CSPX in EUR) and says the product 'is also listed on: Tel Aviv Stock Exchange, Bolsa Mexicana De Valores, Santiago Stock Exchange, ...'; the Tel Aviv line is record 1159250.

fixed_management.notes: Total expense ratio (TER) of the share class as the factsheet prints it; a UCITS TER is the all-in ongoing charge, so the Israeli fee layers (variable fee, trustee fee) do not exist here (ETF-27: 'אין דמי ניהול משתנים'). The factsheet is marketing material dated September 2026, data as at 05-Oct-2026; the KIID/prospectus was not opened.

source.title: iShares Core S&P 500 UCITS ETF U.S. Dollar (Accumulating), CSPX, factsheet 'October 2026', iShares VII plc, p. 2 'Calendar year performance'

tracking_difference_12m.notes: Not printed as one number. The factsheet 'October 2026' (marketing material; performance as at 31-Oct-2026) prints the fund's return and its benchmark's for each calendar year 2016 to 2025 on p. 2; they are in tracking_record. Fund basis: 'Performance is shown on a Net Asset Value (NAV) basis, with gross income reinvested where applicable', in US dollars. Benchmark as the document names it: 'S&P 500 Index'; the iShares VII plc prospectus (p. 33) makes the objective its net total return, so the benchmark is recorded as net (tracking_record.benchmark). The factsheet does not say whether the S&P 500 figures are net or gross of withholding tax on dividends; the fund's own Israeli prospectus annex (p. 9) says the fund follows the index's net total return, so the benchmark is recorded as net (tracking_record.benchmark). The difference is not computed here (data-update rule).

fund_level_withholding_drag.notes: Not computed here (data-update rule). The fund holds the shares physically and is domiciled in Ireland, so US dividend withholding is a fund-level cost at the treaty rate (TXF-16: 15% US-Ireland); the factsheet prints no withholding figure. The engine may compute the drag (method A-11) from these inputs; this record only states them.
